folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B228, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All F, LP, OW, RC, RF and SL rows, service/livelihood tables and source-qualified institutional comparisons were read. The palette’s seven status categories are composable local claims/rights, not a global moral, intelligence or biological enum. body.ownerId, a loan’s holder, legal title, executive control, a person’s willingness and affectionate regard answer different questions. An asserted or enforceable claim can coexist with the subject’s disagreement, and a material custody transfer can work without creating a mind-control or love effect (AD32/AD38).

Preserve actual event differences: emancipation, escape, adjudicated title and termination of a magical bond are different outcomes; inherited objects, memories, personal trust and continuing obligations have different recipients. Finding a dormant sentient item does not itself settle title or create a replacement copy. Coercive premises can constrain acts through a supported rule without calling the result voluntary consent or imposing invented backlash. Scope of travel/work/channel agreement is narrower than sale, invasive repair, reproduction or borrowing a purse. Player premise choice and character agreement are separate.

Evidence is audience-local: deliberate behavior, shared convention, a credential, specialized sensing and a witnessed transition support different claims. A copied signal can show communication without exclusive identity, and a correction may not reach every recipient of a false rumor. The proposed rumor chain needs an actual reporter, reachable recipient and later consumer. F6 ambient chatter is not that network; F7 regional reputation or price margin does not prove universal observer knowledge, fear, law or disguise recognition. B201/B215/B218 retain later scoped memory/recognition evidence without implementing every proposed reader here.

Service prices can follow actual usage, inclusive provision, subsidy, agreed sharing or local discrimination. A larger fee alone cannot cure physical nonfit. Risk-sensitive pricing requires an actually known relevant hazard rather than hidden identity. An agent holds the agreed stock/funds and returns its actual receipt/unspent balance; inability to count coins need not erase earnings or magically grant expertise. The six livelihood groups are proposed buyers/consumers, not provisioned jobs. Body support, optional advancement and money debt are distinct; refusing an unaccepted offer creates no invented contract. A creditor’s shell title does not automatically extend to the occupant or every future body.

Supplied lore examples retain their institutional era, edition and secondary/MTL bounds; this review authenticates no civil code or current source. The finite exchange’s two-hands gate is one historical operation, not proof every trade route is unavailable. A horse script is not a general agency system. Current broader scope, Klein/LOTM/Harry direction, desktop/prose-first targets and AD42/AD51 qualify the old milestone, world-order and viewport/gate wording. B187/B226/B227 retain actual economy, crossing and making distinctions. No rights system, rumor network, body debt, price rule, lease, quote, command or native/persistence behavior was implemented or tested here.
